slides.title: CHAPTER 2 · The Voice Sets the Clock

units.en: The voice sets the clock for everything.
units.zh: 配音决定了一切的时间。

units.en: The script is read aloud by a computer voice,
units.zh: 文稿由电脑语音朗读出来，

units.en: and we learn the exact moment each word is spoken.
units.zh: 我们也因此知道每个词是在哪一刻说出来的。

units.en: Every circle and label is tied to a word.
units.zh: 每个圆、每个标签都绑定在一个词上。

units.en: When the voice says "network", the network appears.
units.zh: 旁白说到"network"时，网络就出现在画面上。

units.en: So pictures, voice, and subtitles always stay in sync.
units.zh: 所以画面、配音和字幕始终同步。

source_text: The voice sets the clock for everything. The script is read aloud by a computer voice, and we learn the exact moment each word is spoken. Every circle and label is tied to a word. When the voice says "network", the network appears. So pictures, voice, and subtitles always stay in sync.
